headline: Rockwell Group eschews 90-degree angles for Skywalker Grill at Lucas Museum
context: Here's a closer look inside the newly opened Lucas Museum of Narrative Art, where design studio Rockwell Group has outfitted a restaurant and bar that "responds to the museum's distinctive biomorphic architecture". Rockwell Group's Los Angeles office designed the Skywalker Grill

sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: Here's a closer look inside the newly opened Lucas Museum of Narrative Art, where design studio Rockwell Group has outfitted a restaurant and bar that "responds to the museum's distinctive biomorphic architecture". Rockwell Group's Los Angeles office designed the Skywalker Grill without a single 90-degree angle, continuing the sweeping curves of the building by MAD The post Rockwell Group eschews 90-degree angles for Skywalker Grill at Lucas Museum appeared first on Dezeen .
